Post revisions are implemented. `bun run typecheck` passes and `bun test` passes (13 tests across 3 files, 11 of them new); `bunx guren gate` is green on all six stages. Nothing is committed — the changes are in the working tree.

## How it behaves

- **Edits keep the previous version.** A successful save copies the title, excerpt and body it is about to replace into `post_revisions`, in the same transaction as the overwrite. Creating a post, or an edit that is refused (422 or 403), keeps nothing.
- **Restore is an edit.** It goes through the same path, so the version just before the restore becomes a new revision and the restored one stays in the list.
- **Author only.** Both routes sit in the existing `auth` group (guests go to `/login`) and authorize as `update` on the post (non-authors get 403).
- **Wrong post answers 404.** A revision is looked up by its id and the post's id together, so another post's revision is not found even when the same author owns both.
- **Delete removes the history.** Revisions are deleted explicitly alongside the post, because SQLite only enforces the `ON DELETE CASCADE` when foreign keys are switched on.

A save that changes nothing still keeps a revision; the request left that case open.

## Additions you did not ask for

- An ADR, `docs/adr/0002-keep-post-revisions-on-every-edit.md`, recording the decisions above.
- An index on `post_revisions.post_id`.
- The revisions page also receives `post` and each revision's `excerpt`, alongside the required `id`, `title` and `createdAt`.

## Summary

I added the `post_revisions` table to `db/schema.ts` with a generated migration in `db/migrations/20260929185703_create_post_revisions/`, and a new `app/Models/PostRevision.ts` model. `app/Models/Post.ts` gained a `revisions` relation plus `Post.revise()` and `Post.deleteWithRevisions()`, which `PostController.update` and `PostController.destroy` now call. The two new routes (`posts.revisions.index`, `posts.revisions.restore`) are in `routes/web.ts`, served by the new `app/Http/Controllers/PostRevisionController.ts` with `app/Http/Resources/PostRevisionResource.ts` and a `PostRevisionParamsSchema` in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`. The frontend has a new `resources/js/pages/posts/Revisions.tsx` page and a "History" link for the author in `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx`. Tests are in `tests/PostRevisionController.test.ts`, and the `.guren/*.gen.ts` manifests were regenerated by codegen.
